stem: In which sentence does the author’s use of language best convey a comforting mood?

options.label: A
options.text: After a long and bumpy ride, Uncle Stephen parked the car near a sparkling lake. (paragraph 20)

options.label: B
options.text: With little enthusiasm Brody also cast his line, swatting at pesky insects that swarmed all around him. (paragraph 21)

options.label: C
options.text: Brody cast his line again and thought about his uncle’s response. (paragraph 24)

options.label: D
options.text: Instead, the silence enveloped him like a welcoming friend, inviting his imagination to wander. (paragraph 26)

visual_elements: After a long and bumpy ride, Uncle Stephen parked the car near a sparkling lake.
